purpose: Harden the v1.0.4 retention repair deployment path so the next host action is one CWD-independent, fail-closed, recoverable redeploy rather than repeated manual diagnostic cycles.

pass_1_correctness_idempotence: Explicit service restart replaces enable --now ambiguity for an already-active service.
Installer remains idempotent for existing users/groups/repo/key/runtime paths.
Public HTTPS install smoke uses bounded retry.
Verified wrapper checks clean worktree, exact origin/main, frozen installer hash and bash syntax before sudo.
pass_2_security_boundary: GitHub write denial is accepted only from explicit permission-denied semantics; transport failure is indeterminate and fails closed.
Deploy-key authorization guidance is emitted only for explicit auth/repository denial after bounded read retries.
Launch/cancel/prune remain the only sudo helper paths.
Prune helper independently rechecks fixed root, canonical job ID, manifest/result, job ID match, retention eligibility and inactive state.
pass_3_recovery_observability: Service startup health requires all launch/cancel/prune bridges.
Failed new-service restart triggers bounded restoration of prior server/unit/env/policy/sudoers before stopping.
Wrapper verifies the running service actually restarted by comparing ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic.
Wrapper verifies installed server contains the retention-prune binding and rechecks all three root helpers.
Relative current working directory is removed as an operator dependency.

pre_root_mutation_gates: wrapper path resolves from BASH_SOURCE rather than current working directory
installer_pre_restart_gates: GitHub read PASS after bounded retries
GitHub write DENIED_AS_REQUIRED by explicit permission rejection
post_restart_gates: isolated offline install job self-test PASS
public-research network sandbox self-test PASS after bounded transport retry
wrapper proves service start timestamp changed when service was previously active
wrapper rechecks installed retention binding and all three helper self-tests
rollback_boundary: If the newly installed MCP service cannot restart and a prior active runtime backup exists, restore prior server.py, service unit, env, policy and sudoers, daemon-reload, attempt restart of the prior runtime, emit diagnostics and stop. No automatic research execution follows a failed redeploy.
research_authorization_effect: NONE. Infrastructure repair only. It does not authorize historical market-body access, outcomes, collectors, Runner execution, trading or changes to frozen research rules.
next_after_host_redeploy_pass: Strategy Manager calls get_test_executor_info and requires privilege_bridge.ok=true and filesystem_boundary.ok=true.
Run exactly one known-good offline run_repo_test.
Only after both PASS may exact T1 public_research metadata-only H1 source qualification proceed.
